message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 21 November 2026, 23:40 UTC to 22 November 2026, 23:40 UTC (23 November, 05:10 IST). **Scope:** Products.txt only, with obvious aliases normalized and duplicates removed, plus the required MongoDB ecosystem sweep.

No newly reported, credibly verified vulnerabilities matching the monitored products were identified in the 24-hour window. Search indexing and incomplete publication timestamps limit coverage; this is not proof that no vulnerabilities exist.

**MongoDB ecosystem:** The sweep covered MongoDB Server and editions, mongod and mongos, Atlas and services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, database tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm and App Services, and official libraries and integrations, including advisories without MongoDB in their titles. A 22 November third-party driver brief references a CERT-Bund advisory originally published on 19 November, so it is not treated as a new disclosure. [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts); [CERT-Bund advisory summary and history](https://www.openadvisories.org/advisory/WID-SEC-2026-4701).

**Closing:** No immediate review is recommended on the basis of a new finding in this scan. Continue addressing previously disclosed vulnerabilities; this scan does not establish that older critical issues have been resolved.
